context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 134 tested the Naukri bulk import chunking fix. The fix addresses HTTP 503 errors on production by chunking candidates into batches of 50 on the frontend before sending to backend. Key implementation: handleSave function in BulkImportPage.jsx (lines 110-158) splits validCandidates into chunks of CHUNK_SIZE=50 and sends them sequentially. Progress bar shows batch progress with current/total, successful, merged, failed counts. Backend /api/admin/bulk-import/save endpoint handles each chunk independently. The backend hasn't changed - it still processes an array of candidates, but now receives smaller batches that complete within gunicorn timeout.
